# Erlang style staffing

`customer_support.df.queue_management.erlang_style_staffing` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Interval-level staffing — size the rota against the shape of arrivals across the day and week, plus the variance around it, never against the period total.

A daily or weekly total tells you nothing about whether anyone was on shift when the work arrived. Support demand has structure — time of day, day of week, release cadence, billing cycle — and staffing that ignores the structure fails predictably.
